ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent workflow system that takes student grievances, executes tool-calling to verify records in university databases, routes them to the correct department, and auto-generates resolution tracking logs.
ideas.title: AgenticCampus: Autonomous Academic Grievance Resolution Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Agentic Harness track by showcasing multi-step tool-calling, autonomous routing, and clear real-world utility for an educational institution like UEM Jaipur.

ideas.pitch: An agentic system for university computer labs that detects hardware or software failures via log parsing, runs diagnostic tools, and automatically files structured GitHub issues or IT service tickets.
ideas.title: LabSentinel: Automated Computer Lab Incident Response & Repair Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates actual autonomous decision-making and tool use in a closed loop, matching the winning pattern of autonomous data/incident response systems.

ideas.pitch: A mobile-first web app tailored for rural farmers to upload crop leaf photos, get instant AI triage and disease severity scoring, and receive localized preventive care instructions in regional Indian languages.
ideas.title: AgriPulse: Localized Crop Disease Triage and Multi-Lingual Advisory Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high social impact with computer vision triage, following the winning pattern of localized health/agriculture triage tools with multilingual support.

ideas.pitch: A geospatial dashboard analyzing open-source satellite and campus utility data to track solar panel efficiency and open-dump waste accumulation across institutional grounds.
ideas.title: SmartCampus Energy & Waste Compliance Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses satellite monitoring for concrete environmental and land compliance impact, mirroring the success of regional industrial monitoring tools.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision system utilizing pose estimation to monitor ergonomic posture compliance and detect suspicious candidate movement patterns during online remote examinations with confidence-gated alerts.
ideas.title: ExamShield: Biomechanical Proctoring and Posture Anomaly Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a technically challenging real-time video processing problem using lightweight pose models, matching the proven architecture of sports biomechanics analysis.
